question: Can every represented positive-energy endpoint and action-residual coordinate be typed against the authoritative local species while resolving the 410-coordinate scalar test doublet without promoting the formal 8,980-coordinate comparison source?
answer: Yes, on the declared energy-2-through-6 represented domain. All 4,080 minimal D-finite coordinates crosswalk exactly from eight harmonic sectors to six typed local endpoint species. The remaining 410 coordinates are 205 exact comparison-only scalar test doublets; because they are absent from the thirty local endpoint species and have no action-derived local dictionary, they are explicitly excluded from the authoritative source rather than assigned inferred BV semantics. All 470 primal residual rows and 470 compact-source action-dual rows are fully namespaced and source-matched. This completes M1A3, not the M1A4 immutable ledger freeze or Gate A.

scope.represented_domain: finite D x SO(4)-finite BGG-adapted harmonic sum
scope.arithmetic: finite exact integer labels, gradings, sparse q0 entries and content hashes

crosswalk_contract.local_to_harmonic_resolution: A tensor harmonic is crosswalked to one local generator species and its complete component-row family, not falsely to one position-space component.
crosswalk_contract.chain_bv_sign_rule: chain_degree=-bv_ghost_number on every authoritative represented endpoint and action-residual row
crosswalk_contract.compact_weight_rule: positive-frequency primal rows have compact weight +energy; conjugate action-dual rows have compact weight -energy
crosswalk_contract.test_fixture_rule: comparison-only rows without an action-derived local dictionary receive explicit NOT_APPLICABLE local BV fields and are excluded from the authoritative source
crosswalk_contract.formal_source_rule: the 8,980-coordinate formal cotangent completion is a comparison object and is not imported as the local BV source

test_nonminimal_disposition.reason: the D-finite producer added a scalar test doublet after the eight minimal sectors; it is not a harmonic realization of any of the thirty endpoint species
test_nonminimal_disposition.effect: the authoritative represented endpoint has dimension 4,080; the wider 4,490-coordinate fixture remains available only as a scoped SDR control
